title: notifications: store the push device's origin on sys_user_device and copy it into push data (ruling B on #29642, server half)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Filing gate: ② a maintainer ruling's server half. Ruling B on #29642 (record 6593872191, maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-03T02:26Z): "the Console sends the origin it was loaded from in `RegisterDeviceRequest`. The server stores it on the `UserDevice` row, and the push channel copies it into `PushDeliveryDataSchema`." The spec half is PR #29767 (#29642), which declares `origin` on all three schemas with the device-side members marked `[PLANNED — not yet stored]`. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2 (inherits #29642; without it the declared `origin` is never stored or sent, so the mobile shell still opens a tap on the wrong server).

**Business reason.** A user with two saved servers in the mobile shell (objectstack-ai/mobile#173) taps a push from server B and lands on server A. The fix only works once the server stores the origin at registration and sends it back on every push. Reader: the `domain:server` seat, after PR #29767 merges.

## What to build (measured by the #29642 dev, os-dev-report 6595041258)

- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/user-device.object.ts`: `sys_user_device` gains an `origin` field beside `app_id` / `locale`.
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/device-registry.ts`: the row write stores `request.origin ?? null` (beside `app_id: request.appId ?? null`, `locale: request.locale ?? null`), and the row read sets `device.origin` when present (beside `if (row.locale) device.locale = …`).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/notifications.ts`: no edit needed; `POST /devices` already passes `parsed.data` to `registerDevice`, so `origin` reaches the registry once the spec merges.
- The push channel (#29041): copy the device row's `origin` into the push `data` (`PushDeliveryDataSchema.origin`). `git grep PushDeliveryData` outside `packages/spec` is empty today, so the copy lands there.
- Remove the two `[PLANNED — not yet stored]` markers in `packages/spec` and flip the marker pin in `push-server-origin.test.ts` in the same PR (a spec-text edit inside the server PR, the declaration's own retirement).

## Out of scope

- The Console sending `window.location.origin` at registration rides #29042.

Serial: after PR #29767.

Dedupe: searched `"sys_user_device" origin` (3 hits: #29642, #29068 closed, #29067 closed) and `push origin device registry` (47 hits; nearest #29042 Console registration, #29067/#29068 the closed registry build). **New.**

Links back: #29642, PR #29767, #29042, #29041, objectstack-ai/mobile#174.
